verdict.rationale: Omnara is a platform for launching/managing agents (dashboard, CLI, REST API, TypeScript SDK) rather than itself being an agent, so an official MCP server it exposes for external connection would be a fair ask. The evidence only shows the reverse direction — Omnara's agents can consume external MCP servers (omnara-docs-5, omnara-docs-17) — with no mention of Omnara publishing its own MCP server endpoint for other agents/clients to connect to.
